title: Ghame hussain Manana Bohat Zaroori Hai
body:
Ghame hussain Manana Bohat Zaroori Hai
hussaini Shamma Jalana Bohat Zaroori Hai
1. Yeh Woh Hussain Hai Jo Fakhr-e1bn-e-aadam Hai ke Jis Ke Zer-e-qadam Rif'at-e-do'aalam Hai
usi Hussain Ke Gham Me Yeh Shor-e-matam Hai
yeh Baat Sab Ko Batana Bohat Zaroori Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Woh Jis Me Asghar-e-masoom Ka Tabassum Hai
woh Jis Me Aag Ka Sailaab Hai Talaatum Hai
woh Jis Me Aakhri Shabbir Ki Sad Gum Hai
woh Baat Sab Ko Sunana Bohat Zaroori Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Woh Jisne Deen Bachaya Hai Karbala Aakar
woh Jisne Aakhri Sajda Kiya Tah-e-khanjar
woh Jiske Dar Pe Farishte Jhuka Rahe Hain Sar
sar Unke Dar Pe Jhukana Bohat Zaroori Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Woh Bhoook-o-pyaas Woh Barchi Woh Seena-e-akbar
woh Mashk Aur Woh Baazu Kate Jo Dariya Par
woh Sheh Ka Aaqri Sajda Who Shimr Ka Khanjar
har Ek K Yaad Dilana Boht Zaroori Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Khamoosh Aal-e-muhammad Ka Aaj Dera Hai
bala Ka Shaam-e-ghareeba'n Me Ek Andhera Hai
rasool Zaadiya'n Aur Khaak Par Basera Hai
aza Ka Farsh Bichana Bohat Zaroori Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Hussain Hi Toh Sahara Hai Aadmi Ke Liye
hussain Hi Ki Zaroorath Hai Zindagi Ke Liye
urooj Azm-e-hussaini Ki Bartari Ke Liye
nashan-e-raah Batana Bohat Zaroori Hai
